instantiate_operator: instantiate a static or dynamic operator by name using instantiate_operator with the operator string, side, num_dynamic_rels, and dim
create_diagonal_operator: create a DiagonalOperator that scales embeddings element-wise with a learnable diagonal vector parameter
create_translation_operator: create a TranslationOperator that adds a learnable translation vector to all embeddings
create_affine_operator: create an AffineOperator that applies a learnable linear transformation matrix and translation to embeddings
create_complex_diagonal_operator: create a ComplexDiagonalOperator that multiplies embeddings treated as complex numbers by a learnable complex diagonal
